mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `article` WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `article` WHERE status = 1
AND category = #{category}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `article` (title, summary, content, cover_image, category, author_id, view_count, like_count, status, is_top, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{coverImage}, #{category}, #{authorId}, 0, 0, 1, #{isTop}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE `article` SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `article` SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
